description: OSM Power Plants is Open Energy Transition's Python package for extracting mapped generation facilities from OpenStreetMap into a modelling-ready table. It parses fuel type, technology, capacity, coordinates and commissioning year, and writes rejected features with reason codes to CSV and GeoJSON for mapper review. Inputs are a country selection and live OSM power-plant tags; outputs are plant tables and optional rejection reports. Geographic coverage follows countries requested, while the data date is the OpenStreetMap extraction time, not a fixed series. The package is free under MIT terms through GitHub and PyPI, with command-line and Python examples in the README. The source OSM data have their own ODbL terms. A limitation is that plants without usable capacity or technology tags can be excluded; the rejection report makes those gaps visible. The generated inventory can supply generation units for power-capacity and hazard-exposure simulations. The catalogue's data-open-infrastructure-map is a related map of OSM assets, whereas this package produces structured plant inputs. No country extraction was run.
